name: Bertoua

routes.outcome: Official MINDCAF site loaded and identifies the Ministry of State Property, Surveys and Land Tenure as the national first-party cadastral/land custodian.
Official English documentation page loaded and describes the regional cadastral service responsibilities; no Bertoua parcel download or public parcel API was exposed in the search result.

Official MINHDU WEB-SIG page was indexed and rendered by the discovery service. It exposes advanced region/department/commune filters and an 'Informations sur les parcelles sécurisées' theme, but the indexed page did not expose a stable parcel endpoint or native parcel identity.
Direct TLS-verified anonymous curl request timed out after 20 seconds; no retry with credentials, bypass, or TLS disablement was attempted.

Official Bertoua 2e municipal urbanism page was found. It describes local planning and urbanism responsibilities, including urban-planning acts and subdivision procedures, but provides no public parcel geometry service.
Official Bertoua 1er municipal services page lists Urbanisme among municipal services; it does not expose a parcel map or downloadable parcel geometry.

schemaAndCrs.geometryCrs: Not exposed by the indexed page or the timed-out direct GET; no geometry response was obtained and no CRS conversion was performed.
schemaAndCrs.nativeIdentity: No public native parcel identity field was returned. No synthetic identity was created.

boundedAnonymousResponse.requestScope: one TLS-verified anonymous GET to the official MINHDU WEB-SIG page and indexed public-page inspection

localCustodianAssessment: Bertoua municipal urbanism pages evidence a local planning/service custodian, while MINDCAF is the first-party national cadastral and land-tenure custodian. The MINHDU WEB-SIG is an official public geospatial service, but its parcel-related theme was not demonstrated to return public cadastral polygons in this attempt.

qualification.reason: Custodial and public viewer evidence exists, but no safe native parcel identity plus full polygon was returned; adapter qualification remains a separate serial review.

scopeLimits: The exact WUP point was preserved in latitude/longitude order and was not shifted.
A timeout and absence of an indexed API are route limitations only, not evidence of citywide parcel absence.
Municipal urbanism pages evidence service scope but not public cadastral geometry coverage.
No owner, address, contact, titleholder, tax/account, or personal fields were requested or retained.
No GeoJSON sample is retained because no safe full parcel polygon and native identity were returned.
Larger request/cache evidence belongs under ignored tmp/valhalla-parcel-research/2941/; the direct page request timed out before producing a response file.
uncertainty: The existence of official municipal urbanism services, the national MINDCAF custodian, and the MINHDU WEB-SIG is first-party evidenced. Public parcel coverage, API discoverability, schema, CRS, update cadence, licensing, geometry availability, and runtime adapter behavior remain unresolved. The packet is complete for attempt 1 and remains held for serial review.
